purpose: Prepare lawful public listening sources for A1-C2 teaching goals under the current user-authorized qualification gates without relaxing source, evidence, scoring, technical audio or device rules.

target.perLevelQuotaNote: No numerical allocation has been approved. Maintain separate A1-C2 inventories and verify usable teaching, task and transfer coverage at each goal before claiming six-level completion.

publicInputAllowlist.rightsBoundary: The corpus licence does not replace exact original-edition text rights, applicable-region review, attribution or third-party audio checks.
publicInputAllowlist.processing: Reuse the existing explicit-partition scale pipeline and frozen ASR parameters. Retain complete original recordings, transcripts, metadata, editions, exclusions, phase manifests and archive/member hashes.
publicInputAllowlist.longWindowBoundary: Segmented utterances do not establish continuous long listening. No stitching, padding or reconstructed continuity. Longer source audio requires a separately allowlisted acquisition and exact continuous-window review.

plannedSources.boundary: Reuse existing audited metadata only within its recorded scope. Do not treat an agency label or historical rights review as approval for a new programme, music, third-party voice, window or territory. Exact public input URLs and rights evidence must be reviewed before adding another acquisition to the allowlist.

No acquisition, redistribution or acceptance is authorised by this entry. Verify the exact dataset version, speech and transcript rights, notices and applicable-region restrictions before proposing public input URLs.

inventoryContract.levelMeaning: Teaching goal and supported task route; not calibrated material difficulty or a learner proficiency classification.
inventoryContract.unmeasuredRule: Unknown counts remain null, never assumed zero or passed. Every count must reference a dated manifest and exact inspected scope.
inventoryContract.globalCountRule: Deduplicate windows across packages, levels, routes, exports and repeated runs before counting towards 5000. A window routed to several goals counts once globally.
inventoryContract.overlapRule: Repeated packaging, transcoding, clipping the same assessed evidence or producing overlapping variants must not inflate the qualified total. Retain overlap provenance and count only independently accepted distinct windows; never count duplicate source/evidence windows.
notCountable: the same window under another level

qualification.passRule: Every gate requires dated evidence tied to the exact current bytes and window. Missing evidence remains pending. A failed or held gate excludes the window from fullyAccepted.

gates.requiredEvidence: Official source identity, complete acquired originals, archive/member hashes, safe extraction, original transcript and edition bindings.
Separate text and recording redistribution terms, attribution and notices, applicable-region scope, and music/third-party speaker restrictions.
Exact source/context review retaining religious, uncertain-context, copyright and quality holds; no automatic clearing of historical exclusions.
Exact start/end in one original recording, complete transcript/evidence spans and boundary margins; no omitted or spliced audio, stitching or padding.

Exact complete current audio/transcript/evidence binding, full-frame decode, sample/time continuity and technical boundaries/margins with retained diagnostics and context. Record actual checks; ASR or decoding alone does not pass the other source, rights, teaching/scoring or device gates.

Appropriate three-language instructional support, exact-source questions/options/answers/scoring and failure cases, and same-operation application from a different root, without widening parsers or evidence rules.
Actual installed package playback, seeking/replay and evidence boundaries offline on the recorded device, including audio/resource failure handling; identify viewport, device and environment.
Actual answer-save transactions and completed-status ordering, backup/recovery and retained source/media hashes; preserve Practice/Test snapshot equivalence and assistance restrictions.

qualification.fullyAcceptedRule: All listed gates must pass for the same unique current-byte window. Local preparation, green tests, ASR agreement, a licence label or GPU use cannot substitute for a missing gate.
qualification.externalProductGates: Real provider/client, two-device conflicts, physical-device/screen-reader, carrier-network and production acceptance remain separately recorded. Qualified-window totals alone do not establish complete product or release acceptance.
qualification.capabilityClaims: Do not claim CEFR calibration, learner proficiency, examination scores, theta, standard errors or learning effects from source counts, routing, synthetic data or successful generation.

auditoryReviewPolicy.authority: Explicit user instruction 2026-10-11: all listening audio no longer requires auditory review.
auditoryReviewPolicy.historyBoundary: Keep actual historical no-audition records and frozen code/evidence unchanged. The waiver does not imply listening was performed and does not bulk-approve or clear any other hold.

executionBoundary.cloud: Configured Colab CLI on a task-owned runtime; A100 use is authorised for measured acceleration. Upload only this explicitly allowed public input and processing code, never credentials or private learner/research data.
executionBoundary.retrieval: Verify complete raw archive or source parts and all manifest/member hashes locally before advancing acceptance. Preserve failed/interrupted jobs and exact holds; data-only exports are incomplete.
executionBoundary.existingInventory: Keep prior batches, actual no-audition records and cancelled rereview evidence unchanged. Auditory review is no longer mandatory under the current user instruction; historical inventory or approval names do not pass remaining rights, evidence, technical audio, context, teaching/scoring or device gates.
executionBoundary.publication: No commit, push, public release, deployment, real repository or critical configuration change is authorised by this scope file.
